item.title: NEW: CISA Orders Urgent Patch for Two Ivanti Zero-Days Used in Attacks
item.description:
Headline: CISA Orders Urgent Patch for Two Ivanti Zero-Days Used in Attacks

Summary:
CISA has added two new Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog after confirming their use in active attacks. The flaws are chained with a previous bug (CVE-2026-104935) to achieve remote code execution. Federal agencies are under a tight deadline to apply patches, as attackers have been observed performing post-exploitation activities, including credential theft and Active Directory reconnaissance.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Patch Management, Cyberattack

Meta Description: CISA adds two actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, to its KEV catalog, mandating urgent patching.

item.title: NEW: FBI: North Korea's Lazarus Group Behind $6 Billion Binance Crypto Heist
item.description:
Headline: FBI: North Korea's Lazarus Group Behind $6 Billion Binance Crypto Heist

Summary:
The FBI has officially attributed the theft of approximately $6 billion in digital assets from the cryptocurrency exchange Binance to the North Korean state-sponsored threat actor known as TraderTraitor, which is a known alias for the Lazarus Group (APT38). The attack, one of the largest crypto heists on record, reportedly began with the compromise of a DevOps engineer's laptop, allowing attackers to abuse internal wallet infrastructure. The FBI is actively tracking the stolen funds, which were primarily converted to Ethereum.

Severity: High

Categories: Threat Actor, Cyberattack, Data Breach

Meta Description: The FBI formally attributes the $6 billion cryptocurrency heist from Binance to the North Korean state-sponsored threat actor Lazarus Group (APT38).

item.title: NEW: Over 41,000 DHS Employee and Contractor Records Leaked Online
item.description:
Headline: Over 41,000 DHS Employee and Contractor Records Leaked Online

Summary:
The activist group Distributed Denial of Secrets has published the personal and operational data of over 41,000 U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) employees and contractors. The leak includes names, phone numbers, and email addresses, as well as sensitive details about surveillance programs and undercover operations. The data affects personnel from agencies like ICE, CBP, and CISA, posing a significant risk to personal safety and national security.

Severity: High

Categories: Data Breach, Threat Intelligence, Regulatory

item.title: NEW: Email Service Breach Leaks 77 Million Addresses, Sparks Phishing Wave
item.description:
Headline: Email Service Breach Leaks 77 Million Addresses, Sparks Phishing Wave

Summary:
Paycloud Holdings, parent company of the Arara Message email distribution service in Japan, has disclosed a data breach exposing approximately 77 million email addresses. Information from 380 corporate clients was also compromised, though no credit card data was lost. Following the breach, attackers launched a large-scale phishing campaign, sending over 7 million emails impersonating a credit card company to the leaked addresses. Users are warned to be vigilant against suspicious communications.

Severity: High

Categories: Data Breach, Phishing, Supply Chain Attack

Meta Description: The Arara Message email distribution service, owned by Paycloud Holdings, suffered a data breach exposing 77 million email addresses and sparking a massive phishing campaign.

item.title: NEW: Critical RCE Flaw in Linux Kernel's TCP Module Affects Servers
item.description:
Headline: Critical RCE Flaw in Linux Kernel's TCP Module Affects Servers

Summary:
A critical remote code execution vulnerability, CVE-2026-98432, has been discovered in the Linux kernel's memory management subsystem for TCP networking. The flaw carries a CVSS score of 9.8 and can be exploited by a remote, unauthenticated attacker to gain root privileges. Systems with exposed Multipath TCP (MPTCP) listeners are specifically at risk. While there are no reports of active exploitation, the vulnerability's severity and the widespread use of Linux demand immediate attention from administrators.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Threat Intelligence, Patch Management

Meta Description: A critical remote code execution flaw (CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8) in the Linux kernel's TCP memory management allows unauthenticated root access via MPTCP.

item.title: NEW: Android 'SMS of Death' Flaw Allows Zero-Click Remote Device Crash
item.description:
Headline: Android 'SMS of Death' Flaw Allows Zero-Click Remote Device Crash

Summary:
A proof-of-concept exploit has been released for CVE-2026-58882, an Android vulnerability dubbed "SMS of Death." The flaw allows a remote attacker to crash a target device or disrupt its cellular service using a specially crafted, invisible text message. This zero-click denial-of-service attack requires no user interaction and affects Android versions 14 through 17. Google patched the flaw in its October 2026 security updates, but unpatched devices remain vulnerable, with the PoC release increasing the risk of exploitation.

Severity: Medium

Categories: Vulnerability, Mobile Security

Meta Description: A zero-click "SMS of Death" vulnerability in Android (CVE-2026-58882) allows remote denial of service. A PoC exploit is now public, increasing risk for unpatched devices.

item.title: NEW: Ransomware Targets Synology NAS Devices Running Obsolete Software
item.description:
Headline: Ransomware Targets Synology NAS Devices Running Obsolete Software

Summary:
The Hong Kong CERT has issued an alert about a ransomware campaign actively targeting Synology Network-Attached Storage (NAS) devices. The attacks succeed by exploiting a vulnerability that was patched in 2024. Threat actors are specifically targeting devices running unsupported, end-of-life (EOL) versions of DiskStation Manager (DSM), which no longer receive security updates. Users are urged to upgrade to a supported DSM version or replace legacy hardware to avoid data encryption and ransom demands.

Severity: High

Categories: Ransomware, Patch Management, Cyberattack

Meta Description: A ransomware campaign is targeting Synology NAS devices by exploiting an old vulnerability in end-of-life (EOL) versions of DiskStation Manager (DSM) software.

item.title: NEW: CISA Launches 2026 Critical Infrastructure Security & Resilience Month
item.description:
Headline: CISA Launches 2026 Critical Infrastructure Security & Resilience Month

Summary:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has launched its annual Critical Infrastructure Security and Resilience Month for November 2026. The initiative aims to raise awareness and promote best practices for securing the nation's essential systems. This year's focus is on the human element of security and preparing for evolving threats, including those from artificial intelligence. CISA is urging public and private sector partners to focus on identifying critical systems, understanding risks, and maintaining actionable response plans.

Severity: Informational

Categories: Policy and Compliance, Regulatory, Threat Intelligence

item.title: UPDATE: CISA Warns of Actively Exploited Ivanti Connect Secure Flaws
item.description:
Headline: CISA Warns of Actively Exploited Ivanti Connect Secure Flaws

Summary:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added two vulnerabilities in Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. Citing evidence of active exploitation, CISA warns the flaws can be chained by an authenticated attacker to escalate privileges and upload malicious files. Federal agencies are mandated to remediate the vulnerabilities to defend against threats targeting network perimeter devices.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Patch Management, Threat Intelligence

Meta Description: CISA adds two Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, to the KEV catalog due to active exploitation for privilege escalation.
